notify.name: Send a notification
notify.description: Show a temporary TV banner. Standby/offline messages are discarded; nothing wakes the TV or replays on wake.

device_ids.name: TV identifiers
device_ids.description: List of TV Assistant identifiers from the TVs tab, for example [tv_living_room]. Not HA device-registry IDs.

tag.name: Notification identifier
tag.description: Optional letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens. Reuse to replace or dismiss the banner.

dismiss_notification.name: Dismiss a notification
dismiss_notification.description: Remove the currently visible banner with this identifier. Does not wake the TV.

device_ids.name: TV identifiers
device_ids.description: List of TV Assistant identifiers from the TVs tab.

tag.name: Notification identifier
tag.description: The tag used when sending the banner.

user.title: TV Assistant
user.description: Add a panel to edit native launcher profiles. Existing dashboards are not modified. Each TV must be linked voluntarily.
